title: Papuan V2 pilot annotation-assistant agreement analysis
status_note: AI predictions for both candidates are complete and final. Human labeling of the pilot set (experiments/EXP-PAP-004/human_labels.csv) has NOT been performed -- it must be done by a human annotator, independently of the AI predictions in ai_predictions.csv, before agreement_metrics.json/confusion_matrices/report.md can be generated. See report.md in this directory for the full explanation.

pilot_sample.sampling_method: random.Random(seed).sample() over the sorted filename list of data/papuan_v2/faces/

ai_models.description: HSEmotion ONNX classifier applied directly to the CLAHE-preprocessed face crop.
InsightFace ArcFace (buffalo_l/w600k_r50) embedding of the CLAHE-preprocessed face crop, classified by a pre-trained multinomial LogisticRegression.
ai_models.embedding_method: Direct ArcFaceONNX.get_feat() on the existing pilot crop -- no face detection performed (no detection model even loaded); embedding is L2-normalized to match Face.normed_embedding's convention. Fixed from an earlier implementation that re-detected faces on the crop via FaceAnalysis (see superseded_result below).
ai_models.classifier_training_code: tools/train_arcface_classifier.py (R6, trained on legacy manual_labels_export.csv -- NOT retrained on any Papuan V2 data)
ai_models.caveat: The classifier was trained on embeddings produced through InsightFace's full detect+landmark-align pipeline; this direct get_feat() path skips that alignment and relies on the crop already being face-centered (FaceDetector's 20%-padded bbox crop). This is a distributional difference from training input, stated explicitly for the EXP-PAP-004 decision.

superseded_result.note: An earlier implementation reused tools/extract_arcface_embeddings.py's ArcFaceEmbedder, which re-runs InsightFace's own detector on the already-cropped image to obtain landmarks. That re-detection failed to find exactly one face on 50/150 (33%) of pilot images (48 excluded_no_face, 2 excluded_multiple_faces). This was an artifact of redundant re-detection on a tight crop, not evidence of ArcFace+LR being a weaker annotation assistant, and is NOT used as an agreement-analysis input. See docs/EXPERIMENT.md EXP-PAP-003 for the full note.

metrics: PENDING -- see status above. Will populate agreement_metrics.json once human_labels.csv is complete.
